The simulation output must be directed to '/home/ga/SUMO_Output/stopinfos.xml'. The final report at '/home/ga/SUMO_Output/new_stop_report.txt' must contain the 'Target_Edge' (the lane/edge ID where the stop was placed) and the 'Arrival_Time' found in the generated stopinfos.xml.
